subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should accepted gateway-run disconnects keep this PR's timeout-style fresh-session embedded fallback, or should this PR wait for a reattach-first/no-local-result design?
rationale: The patch fixes the same-session duplicate bug, but it intentionally preserves a user-visible recook-first fallback that can still duplicate model/tool execution and delivery; repository policy treats fallback behavior and session state as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Land narrow fresh-session fix
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run fallback boundary for this edge case, land this PR after current-main refresh, and handle reattach-first behavior in the linked follow-up issue.

options.title: Extend to reattach-first now
options.body: Pause this PR and ask the contributor to recover the accepted gateway result before any embedded fallback so accepted disconnects normally execute once.

options.title: Choose mode-specific recovery
options.body: Ask for a hybrid design, such as reattach-first for --deliver and fresh-session recook for interactive stdout, before merging this behavior.

recommendation.title: Land narrow fresh-session fix
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run fallback boundary for this edge case, land this PR after current-main refresh, and handle reattach-first behavior in the linked follow-up issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the agent CLI gateway path and is the best available owner for the fallback product boundary.
